integrity: Exact local-support derivation, finite enumeration of actual sphere outputs, rational moment cross-checks, analytic blocking and factorial-moment arguments. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform q-ary words, q>=3; one non-wrapping length-three permutation operation. Fixed-q Gaussian and n/q-to-finite-lambda compound-Poisson regimes, not a code-rate claim or arbitrary k extension.
title: Gaussian and two-jump Poisson laws for three-symbol permutation-burst spheres
